scope_limits: Prepared resource classes/capacities and retained pool owners are the normal-frame contract; resource creation/change, explicit maintenance, resize and shutdown are separate boundaries.
All normal build/compile/prepare/submit/poll/retire/readback/result drops are included; changing valid input/pass composition uses the same ordinary API, not a replay-only fast path.

WSI counts the full normal epoch. Only synchronous winit/Window Rust work is excluded in this isolated fixture without Renderer Rust workers; native/VMA callbacks always cover the whole epoch. Caller and Renderer native/VMA rows may overlap.
Rust counters require the installed application allocator. VMA host callbacks may include requests forwarded to Vulkan; their VMA/driver origin is not distinguished.

Vulkan MemoryAllocate events are successful VMA device-memory notifications; object/resource factories count attempts. D3D12 committed-resource events include implicit heap attempts. Descriptor events count elements or sets. Categories are not additive physical allocation counts.

Callback-external driver/OS/native allocations, D3D12 bootstrap/CPU shader serialization and test-only legacy native factories are unobserved. An independent audit found no missing factory/destructor/reset hooks in ordinary frame/retire/present paths.
Optional native diagnostics are verified in separate strict runs; timings, physical VRAM, another GPU/driver, Linux real GPU, long-duration endurance and real native OOM/device loss are not claimed.

custom_raster.scope: Caller-defined trusted graphics shader pair, single vertex stream, owned <=128-byte inline words, readonly bindings, blend/depth, complete prepared-set replacement and public three-route composition on Vulkan/D3D12.
guarantees: Trusted static descriptor establishes shader behavior/ABI; native capability and layout checks run at explicit pipeline preparation.
Safe Graph establishes constant byte count, binding/resource ranges, attachment format/depth and initialization, including empty draws.
All recordings, pending execution, result handles and exported/refreshed buffer snapshots return before changing the prepared set; result consumption alone is not result-handle return.
D3D12 result-return anchor is acquired before idle publication and retained by the canonical registry, including across working-set replacement.
Unprepared binding-free and descriptor-bound Raster Programs both return a capacity error before recording.
choices_and_costs: Common limits: 64 selected assets, 4 groups, 16 bindings, 16 Float32 attributes, 128 inline bytes; native Device and root-cost limits also apply.

Vulkan stages a fresh owner with bounded OnceLock slots, preserves fixed Compute/Composite, and commits only after native success; this recreates native state at an explicit change boundary to retain lock-free immutable lookup.
Standard finite mesh parameters convert to generic inline words; generic words do not promise finite floats. Inline dynamic indexing and resource descriptor arrays are unsupported.
D3D12 readback slots may return after final consumption; a small separate Arc token tracks the public result handle through Drop without retaining native readback ownership.
No new mandatory real-GPU CI gate, time threshold, vendor optimization or unmeasured time-performance claim.
